responsibility: This definition module declares mc’s generic list abstraction for SYSTEM.WORD values. It exposes an opaque wlist type and the standard container operations—creation, destruction, append, indexed lookup, first-match index search, counting, duplicate-aware insertion, deletion, in-place replacement, iteration by callback, and duplication—so other mc modules can store raw machine-word-sized values without depending on the internal chunked linked-list representation.
same_name_distinction: This is the public definition module for WORD lists, declaring the opaque wlist type and its exported list operations. Unlike wlists.mod, it does not expose or implement the chunked linked-list representation used to store WORD elements.
